## Summary

Describe the user problem and the change boundary.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated outcome-focused tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] Ran the relevant local checks.
- [ ] Ran browser checks at 375, 768, 1024, and 1440 pixels for frontend work.
- [ ] Updated English and Chinese public documentation when needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages, code comments, and default documentation are English.
- [ ] No secrets, generated build output, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Public API or error-contract changes are documented.
- [ ] The change does not add external browser runtime requests or persistence.
